column3: “trembled violently” renders “trembled a great trembling exceedingly.”
“away from the fertility” renders “from the fatness,” which can mean either “away from” or “of”; NASB takes it as “away from.”
“when you become restless” renders an uncertain verb.
“said to himself” renders “said in his heart.”
“consoling himself” means planning revenge as comfort.
“I am tired of living” renders “I loathe my life.”
